self_assessment: Added User.hidePrivateData(userData, callerUID) to src/user/data.js and applied it in the v3 GET /api/v3/users/:uid handler (src/controllers/write/users.js Users.get), which previously returned the raw user.getUserData() object. The function spreads userData into a new object so the caller's object is never mutated, then resolves User.isAdministrator(callerUID), User.isGlobalModerator(callerUID) and User.getSettings(userData.uid) in parallel and computes isSelf as parseInt(callerUID, 10) === parseInt(userData.uid, 10) so a numeric or string uid on either side still matches (and an empty callerUID for a guest yields NaN, which never equals a real uid). For a caller that is not an admin, not a global moderator and not the target, email is set to '' when the target's showemail setting is false or meta.config.hideEmail is set, and fullname is set to '' when showfullname is false or meta.config.hideFullname is set; hidden fields become empty strings rather than being deleted, so the openapi UserObj schema (plain type: string, no format constraint) still validates. The predicate mirrors the existing profile-page logic in src/controllers/accounts/helpers.js, so API and web UI agree. NodeBB's suite needs redis/mongo plus an npm install that this environment cannot do, so I verified by extracting the new function out of the patched data.js and running it against stubbed User/meta: 21/21 checks pass, covering hidden-for-other-user, visible when the target opts in, global hideEmail/hideFullname overriding an opt-in, self access with number and string uids on both sides, admin and global-moderator access, guest (empty callerUID) behaviour including not being treated as self of uid 0, non-mutation of the input, returning a distinct copy, and preservation of unrelated fields. Both changed files pass node --check; no test file was touched.
